semantics.clock: All state changes on positive clk edge, except asynchronous positive areset edge.
semantics.reset: areset asynchronously sets walking left; held high dominates clock edges. Original: positive edge triggered asynchronous resetting to walk left.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; verification asserts reset before checking outputs.
semantics.moore_outputs: Exactly one action output active after reset: walking left/right, falling aaah, or digging.
semantics.walking_priority: If ground=0 fall preserving direction; else if dig=1 dig preserving direction; else bump in current walking direction reverses direction. Both bumps reverse.
semantics.falling: Ignore bumps and dig; ground=1 resumes original walking direction, otherwise continue falling.
semantics.digging: Ignore bumps and dig; remain digging while ground=1, else fall preserving original walking direction.
semantics.latency: Inputs determine state at next positive clock edge; outputs decode current state without extra registers.

numeric.state_space: Six logical states: walk, fall and dig each retaining left or right direction.
numeric.arithmetic: No counters, arithmetic or duration limits.

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral model with action mode and retained direction grounded in original problem.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs on negative edges, check Moore outputs before positive edge and after NBA settling; assert reset between clock edges.
verification.coverage: All 16 input combinations from each of six logical states; directed priority, direction retention, persistent digging and asynchronous reset cases.
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Pre-reset initial state and behavior for unknown-valued inputs are unspecified; no assertions constrain pre-reset outputs or unknown-valued stimulus.
